capabilities: Edit native .canvas files with rich text cards (headings, lists, to-dos, code, colours)
Build mind maps in five layouts with themes and keyboard-driven re-parenting
Arrange and align images and cards with PureRef-style layout commands
Annotate videos and audio with marks, in/out ranges, and frame stepping
Export boards or selections as PDF, PNG, HTML, or ZIP bundles with rewritten paths
extras: Desktop only (export and attachment handling need the desktop app); installation requires manual download from GitHub Releases. Only bookmark cards access the network to fetch link previews; all exports are local. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: The core Canvas can open the same files at any time without damage.
problem: Obsidian's core Canvas offers only basic card types and has no rich text, mind maps, image arranging, video review, or export beyond what the app itself provides.

relations.evidence: opens and edits your existing .canvas files. The core Canvas can open the same files at any time without damage
Arranging, PureRef-style: optimal, by name / added / path

summary: Infinite whiteboard editor for native .canvas files with rich text cards, mind maps, media annotation, image arranging, and PDF/PNG/HTML export.
